answer: Make every new agent climb a trellis of apprenticeship before it can earn: it must first attest other agents' honest work for a full epoch, collecting work credits that only unlock its own rewards at the summit. The credits are non-transferable, bound to one identity, and expire at the epoch's end, so a single operator running a thousand clones still has to do a thousand epochs of real attestation while a lone agent reaches the summit in one climb, and no nebula of fake stars can be stockpiled.
